subject: Payments onboarding: rail mapping, FX split, and VAT implications
messages:
From: Katya Ivanov <katya.ivanov@acme-analytics.de>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: HSBC Treasury <global.treasury@hsbc.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 13:02:00 +0200
Subject: New customer onboarding — invoice settlement questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call today. We have one operational question from finance before we can schedule our first recurring payment: our local AP runs in EUR but our treasury prefers to pay in USD for FX consolidation. The first invoice (INV-2028-071) is issued in EUR. Can you confirm: 

- Do you accept USD payments that will be converted on your side, or must we pay in EUR?
- If we pay USD, can Redwood guarantee the FX rate or will our bank apply the conversion?
- Who is responsible for intermediary / correspondent bank fees (HSBC charged us ~35 EUR last time on a cross-border USD->EUR)? Can Redwood accept a net-of-fees payment?

Also, we are an EU B2B customer and want to confirm VAT treatment — do you need our VAT ID to apply reverse-charge, or will you charge VAT on the invoice?

Attaching our AP remit rules (acme-vat-declaration.pdf) for reference.

Thanks,
Katya
Katya Ivanov
Head of Finance Ops
Acme Analytics GmbH
katya.ivanov@acme-analytics.de
+49 30 555 1234

Attachments: acme-vat-declaration.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Katya Ivanov <katya.ivanov@acme-analytics.de>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:16:00 +0200
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — invoice settlement questions

Hi Katya — great questions. Below is operational guidance and three practical options so finance can pick what fits your internal controls. TL;DR: we prefer to be paid in the invoice currency (EUR) to avoid unknown intermediary markups; if you need to pay USD we can accept it but Redwood will not accept net-of-fees invoices.

1) Preferred flow (cleanest): pay in EUR to our EUR collection account.
   - Bank: Deutsche Bank Berlin
   - Account name: Redwood Inference EU Ltd.
   - IBAN: DE88 2004 0000 1234 5678 90
   - BIC: DEUTDEBBXXX
   - Reference: INV-2028-071 / Acme Analytics GmbH
   - Charges: ask your bank to send as OUR (payer covers all charges) — note: even OUR sometimes sees intermediary deductions if the sender’s bank strips fields. Add a small buffer (0.2% or fixed €15) if you want to ensure full value lands.

2) If you must pay in USD: two sub-options
   a) USD sent to our USD correspondent (preferred if you want funds credited to USD ledger):
      - Correspondent / Nostro: HSBC Bank plc, New York
      - ABA (for example): 021000021
      - Beneficiary: Redwood Inference US LLC / Deutsche Bank Frankfurt (intermediate)
      - Beneficiary account: 1234567890
      - Reference: INV-2028-071 / Acme Analytics GmbH
      - Note: correspondent fees may be deducted en route — these are typically charged by intermediary banks and are out of Redwood’s direct control.
   b) Let your bank convert to EUR before sending to the IBAN above — this gives you visibility of FX rate and control of fees.

3) Net-of-fees / invoice short payments: Redwood cannot accept invoices that are intentionally net-of-fees (we need full invoice amount credited). If intermediary banks deduct fees, we will reach out to you to reconcile. If you need us to absorb fees as a one-off, we can evaluate but it requires approval from finance and may incur a small service fee.

VAT and invoicing:
- For EU B2B purchases, we can apply reverse-charge provided you supply a valid VAT ID and the invoice shows both parties’ VAT identifiers and a reverse-charge statement. Please send your VAT ID (formatted with country prefix, e.g., DE123456789).
- If we do not receive a VAT ID prior to invoicing, Redwood will charge local VAT and issue a VAT-inclusive invoice; we can reissue only if we can substantiate that the original invoice was incorrect.

Attachments I’m including: a short collection instruction PDF and our sample invoice fields (redwood-eu-collection-instructions.pdf). I’ve copied Laura (billing) and Marissa (finance partnerships) to help with any procurement or special handling.

Next steps: please confirm which payment currency & flow you prefer and share Acme’s VAT ID. If you want USD->EUR via correspondent, we’ll provide the exact intermediary account string for your bank to use.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0123

Attachments: redwood-eu-collection-instructions.pdf
From: Katya Ivanov <katya.ivanov@acme-analytics.de>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: HSBC Treasury <global.treasury@hsbc.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 07:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — invoice settlement questions

Hi Vanessa — thanks, that helps a lot. A couple of quick follow-ups: 

- For the USD correspondent path (option 2a), can you confirm the exact intermediary string we should provide to our bank (beneficiary account / intermediary BIC) so Treasury can map it into its SWIFT template?
- If we elect to have our bank convert to EUR (option 2b), what is the expected ledger date and value date? We need to ensure cutoffs align with our monthly close.
- Finally, for the reverse-charge: our VAT ID is DE295876412. Please confirm you can apply reverse-charge and reissue the invoice without VAT.

I’ll loop in Treasury directly for the USD template once we have the full intermediary line.

Thanks,
Katya
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Katya Ivanov <katya.ivanov@acme-analytics.de>, HSBC Treasury <global.treasury@hsbc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:18:00 +0200
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — invoice settlement questions

Thanks Katya — happy to confirm details below so your treasury can populate the SWIFT template. One note: because correspondent chains vary by sending bank, please treat the ABA/BIC strings below as the recommended mapping; your bank should validate against their paypath.

USD correspondent example (for option 2a):
- Final beneficiary: Redwood Inference EU Ltd.
- Beneficiary account (intermediate): DEUTDEFF1234567890
- Beneficiary bank (Euro clearing): Deutsche Bank AG, Frankfurt, BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX
- Correspondent / Nostro (USD): HSBC Bank USA, N.A., New York
- USD ABA: 021000021
- Correspondent BIC: MRMDUS33XXX (example)
- Beneficiary reference field: INV-2028-071 // Acme Analytics GmbH

Expected timings:
- If you instruct your bank to convert to EUR before sending (option 2b), value date is typically T+0 to T+2 depending on your bank’s FX cutoffs; confirm with Treasury where they maintain their FX window.
- If you send USD to our correspondent, the collection will clear into our EUR ledger after the correspondent conversion/nostro sweep — typical posting is T+1/T+2 to our EUR account. Reconciliation can take an extra day if intermediary memo fields are stripped.

Fees guidance (estimate ranges):
- Payer bank conversion fee / margin: 0.1%–0.5% (varies by bank)
- Intermediary / correspondent fee: typically USD 10–50 (or equivalent) per hop
- Domestic receiving bank fee (our bank): €3–€12

Because of the variability, we recommend either paying in EUR to the IBAN above (best for reconciliation) or if paying USD, your Treasury adds a fixed €20 buffer in the payment instruction to cover likely intermediaries. If a shortfall occurs, we’ll notify you and provide a simple reconciliation statement.

VAT: confirmed — we have captured your VAT ID (DE295876412) and will issue a revised invoice showing reverse-charge (VAT 0% with note: “Reverse-charge — EU B2B supply; buyer VAT ID: DE295876412”). That updated invoice will go to your billing contact within 24 hours.

I’ll attach the collection instructions PDF and a short checklist for Treasury to complete the SWIFT template. If HS BCH (cc’d) needs to provide any specific intermediary instructions on their end, they can reply and we’ll align.

Next step for you: confirm whether Acme prefers EUR direct or USD correspondent path + whether you want us to add a €20 buffer. Once confirmed we’ll mark this payment method as the default for monthly invoices.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0123

Attachments: redwood-eu-collection-instructions.pdf
